description: Every solved postflop pack: preflop line, positions (OOP vs IP), stack, pot, the bet-size trees it is solved under, and the solved boards. Boards use the spaced form ("3h 3d 2s"). NLHE packs list `sizingTrees`: "75" (75% pot every street, the pack id itself) and "33" (33% pot on the flop, then 75%, under the `<pack>-flop33` id); every postflop tool accepts either tree's packId. PLO5 packs (ids starting plo5-) solve one 33% flop tree, flop decisions only. Compact output lists board names per pack. Pass `pack` (the 75% id or the -flop33 id) for that tree's per-board detail and per-flop exploitability where the index publishes a number. Missing exploitability is omitted, never estimated. Pass `variant` to list only NLHE or PLO5 packs. Call this before get_postflop_node.

detail.description: Response detail. "compact" is the default and removes bulk maps; use "full" only when exact complete data is required.

pack.description: One pack id (75% id or the -flop33 id): per-board detail and that tree's exploitability

variant.description: Only packs of this game: nlhe (hold'em) or plo5 (five-card Omaha)
